summary: Separate shared native host and harness-session state helpers from the catalog runner module while preserving existing paths.

schema.detail: No stored data or schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Moved function bodies and shared OnceLock are unchanged; existing public and crate-private run paths are re-exported. Environment precedence, state locations and hostname detection are preserved.

recovery.detail: Reverting the module move restores the former layout without a data change.
